description: Trem Metropolitano - Área de influência is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Área de influência ferroviária. Terrenos limítrofes à faixa ferroviária que devem respeitar a faixa non aedificanti de 15 metros, conforme previsto na Lei Federal n° 6766/1979. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Ambiente construído, Transporte, transportation. The portal shows 2024-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
